description: Source code for the AudioStreamTrack class in the Android Open Source Project, managing audio streaming via AudioTrack, including opening, closing, and control methods.

classes.name: AudioStreamTrack
classes.description: Manages audio streaming using AudioTrack, providing methods for control, configuration, and state management.

methods.name: AudioStreamTrack
methods.description: Constructor initializing the AudioStreamTrack object.

methods.name: ~AudioStreamTrack
methods.description: Destructor that checks stream state and logs if not properly closed.

methods.name: open
methods.description: Initializes and opens the audio stream with specified builder parameters.

methods.name: release_l
methods.description: Releases resources, removes callbacks, and prepares for closing.

methods.name: close_l
methods.description: Closes the stream, stops callbacks, and releases AudioTrack.

methods.name: onNewIAudioTrack
methods.description: Handles rerouting of the AudioTrack, disconnecting if properties do not match.

methods.name: requestStart_l
methods.description: Starts the audio stream and enables callbacks.

methods.name: requestPause_l
methods.description: Pauses the audio stream and disables callbacks.

methods.name: requestFlush_l
methods.description: Flushes the audio stream, resets read positions.

methods.name: requestStop_l
methods.description: Stops the audio stream, resets positions, and disables callbacks.

methods.name: processCommands
methods.description: Processes state transition commands based on current stream state.

methods.name: write
methods.description: Writes audio data to the stream, handling blocking and errors.

methods.name: setBufferSize
methods.description: Sets the buffer size in frames.

methods.name: getBufferSize
methods.description: Returns the current buffer size in frames.

methods.name: getBufferCapacityFromDevice
methods.description: Returns the buffer capacity from the device.

methods.name: getXRunCount
methods.description: Returns the underrun (x-run) count.

methods.name: getFramesPerBurstFromDevice
methods.description: Returns the number of frames per burst from the device.

methods.name: getFramesRead
methods.description: Returns the number of frames read, updating internal position.

methods.name: getTimestamp
methods.description: Retrieves timestamp information for the stream.

methods.name: doSetVolume
methods.description: Sets the volume for the stream.

methods.name: registerPlayerBase
methods.description: Registers the player base ID with the AudioTrack.

methods.name: applyVolumeShaper
methods.description: Applies a volume shaper configuration and operation.
